描述_EN: square of polychrome tapestry added by stitching on a linen ground cloth. it is figured in a reserve medallion inscribed in a square. a large frame is formed by a succession of red medallions, inside which is alternately a cross or a "z". a figure wearing a tunic, a harness, perhaps a stole, and holding a plant element in each hand, occupies the central space. a frieze of outward-facing triangles forms the outer frame.
描述_ZN: 的多色挂毯是在亚麻底布上缝制而成的。 它的特点是在储备的勋章上刻有一个方形。 一个大的框架由一连串的红色奖章组成，里面交替着一个十字架或一个 "Z"。 一个身穿外衣、马具，也许是披肩的人物，双手各拿着一个植物元素，占据了中央空间。 一个由外向型三角形组成的门楣构成了外框。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期；伊斯兰统治时期
